set.body: Meta-epic for the remaining end-to-end display work after the orientation-correct orthogonal viewer foundation. Ordered outcomes: (1) verify and narrowly land the current cache/sampling/Canvas benchmark tranche; (2) add first-class neuroimjs-parity threshold semantics; (3) add typed viewport navigation, flexible layouts, coordinate/intensity readouts, and application-facing host contracts; (4) move sampling latency off the interaction path with measured browser evidence while preserving all orientation and differential oracles; (5) finish the authoritative general graphics roadmap bd-01KX94HQ7CA0NF2ZCH5V3PF3B3. Every implementation slice must pass its affected JVM and Scala.js suites; final closure requires testAll, renderer conformance, and a live browser receipt. Existing unrelated dirty-tree work and active Mote reservations must be preserved.
set.title: Epic: complete the image-view display/render pipeline and converge the graphics stack
